name: Weft
description: Find and buy paid data, APIs, and actions through Weft, with optional native web search.

identity.baseUrl.label: Requester-scoped Weft MCP URL
identity.baseUrl.help: Optional MCP URL used only when requester bindings are configured. Public URLs must use HTTPS.

identity.bindings.label: Requester credential bindings
identity.bindings.help: Map trusted OpenClaw requester identities to Gateway environment-variable names.

webSearch.apiKey.label: Optional web-search Weft key
webSearch.apiKey.help: Used only when Weft is explicitly selected as OpenClaw's native web-search provider.

webSearch.provider.label: Web-search upstream provider
webSearch.provider.help: Use auto for the lowest-price compatible search operation, or pin one provider.

webSearch.maxCostUsd.label: Maximum cost per native web search
webSearch.maxCostUsd.help: Hard USD ceiling for one optional paid web search. Default: 0.01.

webSearch.baseUrl.label: Optional web-search Weft API URL
webSearch.baseUrl.help: Used only by the native web-search adapter. Public URLs must use HTTPS.
